interface.signature: def klengthpref(arr: list[str], n: int, k: int, str: str) -> int:

preconditions.description: The size of the array arr must be between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 1000 for s in arr)
preconditions.description: Each string in arr must have length between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The string str must have length between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The integer k must be between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for s in arr for c in s) and all(c.islower() for c in str)
preconditions.description: All characters in arr and str must be lowercase English alphabets.
The integer k must not exceed the length of str.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for s in arr if k <= len(s) and s[:k] == str[:k])
postconditions.description: The function returns the count of strings in arr whose first k characters match the first k characters of str.
